subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class default remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory facade now, route this to plugin or ClawHub surfaces, or wait for the companion schema/provenance/write-flow decisions first?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the requested command and skill facade depends on durable schema, provenance, write-flow, review/edit/forget semantics, and the special memory plugin slot rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and lifecycle contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin First
options.body: Treat the need as satisfied by external memory plugins or ClawHub skills unless a missing SDK seam is identified.

options.title: Close Into Companion Issues
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the command facade should be decomposed entirely into the open schema, provenance, write, and review-flow issues.

recommendation.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker until schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and lifecycle contracts converge, then build the smallest default facade.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current routing signal for the active memory plugin/product boundary and the current memory-core CLI, schema, and docs surfaces.
